I searched SFO to Tokyo (Narita and Haneda) in business class from March 1 to May 31, 2027, with a limit of 90k points per seat. There are lots of seats, but the cheapest ones have a catch.

## Cheapest: 85k Aeroplan, but with a stop and part of the trip in economy
- **UA9857 + NH9920** (United, then ANA), leaves SFO at 12:55pm, available on most days in March, April and May
- Taxes are about CA$101 per person
- **One stop, and about 15% of the distance is flown in economy.** It's 85k per seat, but not fully business class.
- Usually 1 to 4 seats per flight

## Better: nonstop, fully business class
**ANA via LifeMiles: 87k plus $41 per seat.** This is the NH9107 nonstop to Haneda, which leaves SFO at 1:25am.

| Month | Dates (seats) |
|---|---|
| March | 16 (1), 22 (1), **26 (2)** |
| April | 7 (1), **8 (2)**, 10 (1), 19 (1), **24 (2)** |
| May | 5 (1), **7 (2)**, 10 (1), 19 (1), 20 (1), **23 (2)**, 26 (1) |

**United via MileagePlus: 88k plus $56 per seat.** This is the UA9837 nonstop to Narita, which leaves SFO at 11:20am.
- March 3 (3 seats), 10 (1), 17 (3), 23 (1), 24 (3)

The nonstop search found 36 matches, but the tool only shows 20. The other 16, probably more United dates in April and May, cost between 88k and 90k. I can search those months separately if you want.

## My pick
If you can handle the 1:25am departure, take the **ANA nonstop through LifeMiles**. It's only 2k more than the one-stop flight and you're in business class the whole way. If you want a daytime departure or need 3 seats, take **United** in March.

**How many people are travelling?** You said "each," so I'm guessing more than one. Most ANA dates have only 1 or 2 seats, and United has up to 3 in March. Tell me the number and I'll filter to flights with that many seats.

All of this data was last updated about 2 hours ago. Before you transfer any points, check that the seats are still available on the airline program's own site.

- Taxes are about CAD $101.
- There are 2+ seats on many March dates, for example Mar 3, 4, 6, 12–14, 19, 23, 28–30 and Apr 1.

**Before you move any points:**

- Tokyo's cherry blossoms usually peak in late March to early April, so dates like Mar 26 and Apr 8 will likely be hard to get.
